Main characters occupy 70–80 percent. Preserve recognizable fictional character identities and clothing where specified. Single coherent scene, central safe composition. No card frame, typography, title, words, speech bubbles, letters, numbers, UI, watermark, collage or montage. No money/dice/property-game elements unless the described scene naturally contains them. Scene: Orochimaru from Naruto pale skin long straight black hair narrow golden eyes purple rope belt beige tunic, two-head chibi crouching palm to ground smirking; three enormous stacked-depth oni-faced Rashomon gates rise in perspective, red front gate, green middle, dark blue rear, a harmless golden shockwave breaking into dust against first. Warm earthy light, exaggerated cute oni faces not horror, no blood, no writing.

entries.name: 移花接木
entries.quote: 你再摸摸，东西还在不在？
entries.description: 两人错身而过时，侠盗伸手扶了扶对方快滑落的包袱。失主连声道谢，还顺手拍了拍腰间，确认东西都在。等他低头细看，袋口不知何时多了一枝小花。街角那人已经走远，袖口里，一只刚到手的锦囊轻轻晃了一下。
entries.effect: 抢夺手牌 随机转移对手1张手牌，空手目标保留卡
entries.scene: Original adult chibi wuxia thief with tied black hair and teal cape politely steadying another adult traveler heavy bundle, traveler smiles gratefully while thief secretly slips embroidered pouch into sleeve, tiny pink flower left at belt. Warm bustling ancient street, foreground hands and contrasting expressions readable, no actual text, playful not threatening.

entries.name: 炉石回城
entries.description: 冒险者在泥地里坐下，终于从背包底翻出了那块熟悉的石头。淡绿色的光绕着指尖亮起，耳边的风雨声慢慢远去。再睁眼时，壁炉烧得正旺，旅店老板刚擦好一只杯子。冒险者松了口气，背包上的泥水却已经滴了一地。
entries.effect: 扩展:homeTeleport 替代掷骰，传送到自己的非神威地产并正常结算，可以按原规则付费升级
entries.scene: World of Warcraft inspired adult chibi armored adventurer seated in warm inn holding smooth hearthstone with cyan spiral glowing symbol (pictorial rune only no letters), muddy boots and huge backpack dripping on floor, friendly dwarf innkeeper with orange beard holding mug looking at puddle, cozy hearth fire and round wooden table, faint teal teleport swirl fading around traveler, big relieved expression, no UI or text.
